_README: THE ONE PLACE for the Microsoft Store identity. These values must match Partner Center > your app > Product management > Product identity exactly (Package/Identity/Name, Package/Identity/Publisher, Package/Properties/PublisherDisplayName). DisplayName must be a name reserved for this app in Partner Center. Version must be 4 parts with the last part 0, and must increase for every Store submission.
DisplayName: iPhone Live Photo to Android Motion Photo
Description: Turn iPhone Live Photos into Android and Samsung Motion Photos on your PC.
